correctness.rationale: For all m>=2, exact distinct-ending-symbol recurrence gives determinant-one unipotent maps on primitive mod-m columns. Legal blocks 0 and 10 generate SL2(Z/m), including all inverses by finite-order positivity, so every primitive counter column is reachable with each legal last-symbol flag. Primitive rows give separating legal suffixes for every distinct same-flag pair; an initial 1 distinguishes flags and accepted continuations distinguish the sink. CRT counts primitive columns as J_2(m). The independent finite checker minimizes m=2..20 and performs 38,893 literal-subsequence acceptance checks; the algebraic proof covers all moduli.
